note: Links out to guides, walkthroughs, videos and communities elsewhere. Community pointers, never evidence: nothing here is cited as a source for decoded facts. Keep date_checked current; the weekly link check fails on dead URLs. Each entry names the game it covers: outlanders-2, outlanders-1 (the first game) or both.
